intro: Trying to find merit-based funding in the USA as an international student usually means sorting through programs that look similar at first glance but differ in who they support, what they ask for, and how competitive they may be. This filtered slice brings together a focused set of listings tied to merit scholarships for international students, so you can apply with more direction instead of guessing where you fit. As you compare the rows below, expect variation in award wording, study level, subject focus, essay expectations, and eligibility details. Some listings may be broader across education or community themes, while others lean toward areas like STEM, medicine, arts, or business. Deadlines also vary by program, so it is worth checking the provider application path promptly when a listing looks relevant.
